name: Physical AI Sprint
description: Answers questions about The Physical AI Sprint hackathon and serves its team and project data as JSON.

skills.name: List teams
skills.description: Return the teams at the hackathon, including which ones are still looking for members and what skills they want.
examples: Which teams need a computer vision person?

skills.name: List projects
skills.description: Return the projects submitted to the showcase with their track, robots used, and team.
examples: Which projects used the Unitree G1?

skills.name: Event details
skills.description: Return the date, schedule, hosts, judging criteria, and registration link for the event.
examples: When is the Physical AI Sprint?
